characters.continuity: Pixar Animation Studios The Incredibles films
characters.summary: Edna Mode relies entirely on her genius-level intellect, advanced technology, and high-tech gadgetry rather than direct combat. She designs impervious hero suits equipped with specialized utility features.
weaknesses: No direct superhuman physical combat capabilities
Aversion to capes
limitations: Dependent on physical inventions rather than innate powers

sources.supports: Role as a brilliant fashion designer and inventor of super-hero suits for the Incredibles.

campaignTags.claim: Designs and utilizes specialized high-tech equipment and tracking devices
Engineers advanced bulletproof, fireproof, and bombproof suits for superheroes
Operates high-end laboratory technology and communications

unknowns: True extent of combat skills outside of suit design is unshown

characters.continuity: Pixar Animation Studios The Incredibles films
characters.summary: Elastigirl uses extreme bodily elasticity, shapeshifting, and acrobatic martial arts to subdue opponents. She frequently alters her form into parachutes, gliders, or binding shapes to neutralize threats.
weaknesses: Extreme cold can stiffen her elasticity
Extreme heat can cause temporary fatigue
limitations: Stretching too far can cause strain or vulnerability

sources.supports: Elasticity, shapeshifting abilities, and combat background.

notableResults.note: Subdued using agile combat and teamwork

campaignTags.claim: Can stretch her body into a parachute or glider configuration in mid-air
Can slip through tiny spaces and vents using elasticity
Pilots aircraft including the Incredibile and various stolen planes

unknowns: Exact maximum stretch length without tearing

characters.continuity: Warner Bros. Looney Tunes classic shorts
characters.summary: Elmer Fudd hunts using a double-barreled shotgun and standard hunting equipment, though he is frequently outsmarted by Bugs Bunny. His comedic persistence often leads to self-sabotage.
weaknesses: Easily fooled by disguises and psychological trickery
Prone to accidentally shooting himself
limitations: Relies entirely on standard physical hunting gear

sources.supports: Use of hunting rifle and role as an inept hunter chasing Bugs Bunny.

unknowns: Exact proficiency with weapons outside of classic cartoon gags

characters.summary: Elsa possesses innate, powerful magical control over ice and snow. She generates blizzards, constructs complex structures, and animates ice golems to defend herself.
weaknesses: Emotions like fear or panic can cause her magic to spiral out of control
Vulnerable to physical capture if restrained before casting
limitations: Power level fluctuates based on emotional state

sources.supports: Magical cryrokinesis, ice creation, and emotional ties to her powers.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to generate and manipulate ice and snow
Creates massive ice castles, clothing, and sentient snow creatures
Wields innate magical cryokinetic powers
Casts complex magic spells utilizing ice and winter phenomena

unknowns: Upper limit of destructive output when fully unrestrained

characters.continuity: Walt Disney Animation Studios Frozen II
characters.summary: Fifth Spirit Elsa has fully accepted her magical identity, operating at peak mastery over ice and elemental spirits. She moves with enhanced grace, speed, and deep connection to nature.
weaknesses: Deep emotional attachments to her homeland and family
Vulnerable in environments lacking moisture or cold elements
limitations: Must maintain spiritual balance to sustain peak output
characters.formDifferences: Represents Elsa in her fully realized Fifth Spirit form, possessing enhanced elemental harmony, dominion over the Nokk, and refined magical mastery compared to her initial state.

sources.supports: Elsa embracing her role as the Fifth Spirit and mastering elemental magic.

campaignTags.claim: Advanced elemental control over ice and snow as the Fifth Spirit
Manipulates freezing elements across vast geographic areas
Embodies the bridge between humanity and magical nature spirits
Rides the Nokk water spirit in combat and travel
Performs high-tier elemental magic effortlessly

unknowns: Full potential of combined elemental spirit powers

characters.continuity: Walt Disney Animation Studios The Hunchback of Notre Dame
characters.summary: Esmeralda is a resourceful Romani dancer who fights using agility, deception, and a tambourine or dagger. She excels at evasion and utilizing crowds or urban environments for cover.
weaknesses: Standard human physical durability
Vulnerable when cornered without escape routes
limitations: No superhuman powers, magic, or advanced technology

sources.supports: Acrobatic skills, resourcefulness, and street survival in Paris.

campaignTags.claim: Sneaks through Notre Dame and Parisian streets undetected
Uses shadows and disguises to evade capture by guards

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against heavily armored supernatural foes

characters.continuity: Warner Bros. Looney Tunes classic shorts
characters.summary: Foghorn Leghorn is a large, bombastic rooster who relies on physical brawn, practical jokes, and overwhelming vocal presence to dominate disputes.
weaknesses: Overconfident and easily distracted by his own talking
Susceptible to traps set by smaller adversaries like the Henery Hawk
limitations: Bound by cartoon physics and prone to backfiring schemes

sources.supports: Physical size, boisterous personality, and classic cartoon gags.

unknowns: Actual combat skill outside of cartoon slapstick

characters.summary: Fred Flintstone fights using crude prehistoric tools, immense brute strength derived from heavy labor, and stone-age club weapons.
weaknesses: Prone to panic under pressure
Lacks strategic discipline

sources.supports: Prehistoric setting, physical strength, and work as a quarry worker.

unknowns: Effectiveness against modern or magical combatants

characters.summary: Fred Jones acts as the tactical planner of Mystery Inc., specializing in complex Rube Goldberg-style traps, investigative deduction, and physical brawn.
weaknesses: Overly fixated on building elaborate traps that can fail
Standard human vulnerability
limitations: Requires preparation time to set up effective traps

sources.supports: Role as trap maker, leader of Mystery Inc., and athletic capability.

campaignTags.claim: Constructs elaborate rope nets, cages, and mechanical traps from scratch
Drives and pilots the Mystery Machine and various specialized vehicles

unknowns: Combat prowess without prior trap preparation

characters.continuity: Walt Disney Animation Studios The Hunchback of Notre Dame

Aging physical condition
limitations: Relies heavily on subordinates and judicial authority for power
